definitions.proe: mean nflfastR pass_oe over pass/rush plays, in points of pass rate
definitions.epa_pass: EPA per dropback (scrambles and sacks included)
definitions.expl_rush: share of designed rushes gaining 10+ yards
definitions.deep_rate: share of pass attempts thrown 20+ air yards
definitions.*_rk: rank among the 32 teams within that week (1 = best, or most for proe/aypa/plays, fewest for sack_rate)
definitions.<metric>_n: plays carrying a value for that metric; its exact weight when pooling weeks. Not the same as attempts: nflfastR leaves cpoe and air_yards null on some attempts
definitions.excluded: kneels, spikes, two-point tries, and all non-REG games
definitions.purpose: descriptive matchup context; never an input to the expected-points model
